title: Petition of the Wakefield Municipal Gas and Light Department for authorization and approval of an increase in the rate of depreciation from the statutory rate of three percent to five percent for the year 2004.
filings: DEPRECIATION ORDER- Issued by Commissioners Afonso (Chairman), Connelly, Keating, Manning, Sullivan. DTE 04-28-A

Petition of the Wakefield Municipal Gas & Light Department for approval to use five percent of depreciation of their cost of plant for the gas department for calendar year 2004. By William J. Wallace, Manager. DTE 04-28-A
